verdict: Lowe's sales rose 8% to $26.0B on Pro and online strength, but profit was flat at $2.4B as acquisition expenses and a thinner gross margin offset the growth.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Total sales $26.0B, vs $24.0B a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: the same as a year ago

kpis.label: Comparable sales
kpis.note: fifth straight positive quarter; online sales +15.7%

segments.name: Home improvement retail
segments.note: Lowe's reports a single segment: 1,761 home-improvement stores plus online. Growth was led by Pro (professional contractor) sales, home services and a 15.7% jump in online sales, partly offset by soft do-it-yourself demand.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Running the stores, paying associates and marketing — 17.2% of sales, a little leaner than a year ago.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of stores, distribution centers and systems over their lives — up from $457M as Lowe's invests and adds acquired businesses.

otherDetail: Interest expense, net of $374M — the cost of Lowe's borrowings, net of interest earned.
oneTimers: Lowe's booked $96M of pre-tax expenses tied to its acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials (FBM) and Artisan Design Group (ADG). Excluding them, adjusted EPS was $4.40 vs GAAP $4.27. Both figures include an $0.11-per-share benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds.

takeaways.title: Comps stay positive
takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 0.2% — the fifth straight positive quarter — as Pro, home services and online (+15.7%) outweighed persistent pressure on discretionary DIY spending.

takeaways.title: Margin did the damage
takeaways.text: Gross margin slipped to 33.04% from 33.81% a year ago, so an 8% sales jump produced only 2% more operating income ($3,549M) and flat net earnings of $2,399M.

takeaways.title: Outlook trimmed to the low end
takeaways.text: Full-year fiscal 2026 guidance now points to about $92B of sales (was $92–94B), flat comparable sales, GAAP EPS of about $11.75 and adjusted EPS of about $12.25. Lowe's paid $673M of dividends in the quarter.

footerNote: Lowe's fiscal Q2 2026 ended July 31, 2026 (its Q3 ends around October 30 and is usually reported in mid-November, so Q2 is the latest reported quarter). Lowe's reports a single operating segment, so revenue is shown as one line.
